newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish reverse repo drains 21 bln SKR from market.
newsitem.headline: Swedish reverse repo drains 21 bln SKR from market.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday said it drained 21 billion crowns from the market in its Tuesday morning reverse repurchase operation.
The reverse repo was set at an unchanged, fixed 4.10 percent and will run from January 8 to Janaury 15, replacing an operation that drained 32 billion crowns from the market.
The Riksbank said 5.70 percent of bids for the tender were allocated.
